operating_notes.text: Bidar API campus (Unit IV & VI) transitioned to 100% renewable power in FY26, bringing company-wide renewable power share to nearly 80%.
The Group operates in a single operating segment of Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Services (CRDMO).
Net IPO proceeds of ₹909.88 Cr have been fully utilised as of 31 March 2026 (₹720 Cr for debt repayment and ₹189.88 Cr for general corporate purposes).
FY26 Capex spend stood at ₹633 Cr against a budget of ₹700 Cr.
Bidar manufacturing sites Unit IV and Unit VI operate on 100% renewable power.
Commercial supply qualification received from two additional large pharma customers in FY26.
CMC has 33 active commercial molecules and 14 in late phase as of Q1FY27.
Repeat customers accounted for over 90% of revenue in FY25 and FY26.
Sai works with 19 of the top 25 large pharma companies.

timeline.summary: The Joint Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Appeals) issued a ₹32.86 Cr demand (including interest and penalty) for FY22 GST discrepancies.
Sai Life Sciences Limited invites analysts and institutional investors to a Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 15, 2026, at 4:00 PM (IST) with **Mr. Krishna Kanumuri** and **Mr. Siva Chittor**.
Sai Life Sciences announced that its Bidar API manufacturing campus transitioned to operating entirely on 100% renewable energy.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹602.14 Cr (+3.9% YoY), net profit ₹104.24 Cr (+18.1% YoY).
Sai Life Sciences announced FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,192 Cr (+29% YoY) and outlined an FY27 capex target of ₹1,100–1,300 Cr.
Sai Life Sciences Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website on 15 May 2026.
Krishnam Raju Kanumuri, Promoter of Sai Life Sciences Limited, declared no promoter group encumbrances on shares for FY2026 beyond prior disclosures.
